title: Daande Ƴellitaare Suuɗnde
intro: E nder ɓernde ñaawirde tooñannge, ɗo keefeeraagal woni sariya leydi ndii, ruuhu gooto ina yahra e ŋoral tiiɗngal e goonɗinal e kulol. Oo neɗɗo, ɓadiiɗo caka laamu, heɗiima no nelal annabi ngal hawri e majjere e kulhuli. Wakkati goonga ari, dooli oo neɗɗo suɓaade hakkunde kisal silki e haalde goonga kulɓiniiɗo. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa oo daraniiɗo cuusal ?
clues: Miɗo wuuri e nder galle jom doole en, miɗo seedtoo e hoore am mawnikinaare jaɓnde maandeeji diineeji.
Miɗo joginoo goonɗinal am sirlu, jawdi suuɗndi e nder galle dewal sanamuuji.
Mi nanii hooreejo mo ngollodinoomi oo ina felliti warde nelaaɗo Alla, gorko ina wiyee Muusaa.
Mi naamndiima logic maɓɓe, mi siftinii ɓe hoddiro yimɓe Nuuhu, Ad e Samud.
Miɗo naamndii leñol am naamnal tiiɗngal: ‘So tawii ko o fenaande, fenaande makko ina woni e makko; kono so tawii ko o gooŋɗinɗo, won e ko o fodani on koo ina fiyra on.’
Daartol am ina haalee e yeru goonɗinal e nder suura biyeteeɗo ‘Yaafoowo’, ɗo jeertinirmi leñol am e peeje doole.

trial.label: Hol ko wonnoo ñaawoore am?
options: Faddaade Annabi Muusaa e nder ñaawirdu tippudi
Mahde suudu toowndu ngam yettaade asamaan
trial.answer: Faddaade Annabi Muusa e nder ñaawirdu tippudi

location.label: Hol ko wonnoo tiitoonde hujja am?
options: Ɗaɓɓaande maande ummoraade e lekki ceniiki

outcome.label: Hol ko woni batte mum?
options: Allah hisni oo neɗɗo e peeje maɓɓe bonɗe
Ñaawirde ndee fof jaɓi ɗoon e ɗoon Lislaam
Tiranoowo oo tuubnii e sahaa nde o ronki
Neɗɗo oo riiwaa to leydi woɗɗundi
outcome.answer: Allah hisni oo neɗɗo e peeje maɓɓe bonɗe

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
